observations: SetSysWorkspace assigns only when the reserved pointer is null; a later call alone does not switch the selected system workspace.
The profile NZ AIV instruction window 0x1d538..0x1d548 implements that conditional assignment.
The ordinary frozen FFN calls SetSysWorkspace for bridge then body; each explicit workspace allocation is 16 MiB.
The profile NZ AIV window between marks 3 and 4 contains 71 disassembly lines, 31 LD/LDP and 30 ST/STP instructions. This is a static count, not a hardware stall measurement.
